maintenanceAssessment: Immutable successor of gradle-9-8-1.json that supersedes it only to bind the current GOV.12 asset pins: assetPinsSha256 is required on the last dependency review by verifyMobilePolicy, and the earlier review was committed without it. Every other field, including the Gradle 9.8.1 pin, the input hashes, the versions and the evidence, is identical to gradle-9-8-1.json. Adopt the upstream Gradle 9.8.1 patch release in the admitted Gradle 9.8 line, pinned by its official SHA-256 (dce76f55f8e251a3a1f130eb120f30b3d271de2b76c9b0729d316b5a1b6dc01f) from the Gradle release checksum. The wrapper validated the downloaded distribution against that digest. Android lint flagged the Gradle 9.8.0 pin as NewerVersionAvailable; the 9.8.1 pin clears that Gradle finding. Lint still fails on newer upstream Kotlin 2.4.21 (org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform and org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose) and Spotless 8.10.4, which this change does not admit. Those versions are not moved here. The reviewed 9.7.1 wrapper launcher (gradle-wrapper-9-7-1-r2) is retained. Upstream maintenance remains monitored by Dependabot and the security workflow; this records admission, not a claim of latest versions or no vulnerabilities.
